The content captions match the packet on every row: whys[3] 'pulls ahead by chipping you safely from outside aura range', whys[4] the Realm duel 'win that isolated duel clean', whys[5] 'he pokes you out for free', whys[6] 'his range only grows'. audit.whatIsWrong: (a) whys[2] and wants.foe[1] both say Hexplosive Minefield 'blocks' the Death's Grasp pull / makes it 'whiff'. Riot's text says the mines 'detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing' — they slow, they do not block or cancel a pull. Overstating it tells the player his E is unusable when in fact it still works, just from a worse position. (b) Riot's text also says 'successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage', which is real, actionable counterplay — crossing the field costs less than lingering in it — and appears nowhere. (c) Satchel Charge knocks ZIGGS away too and he takes no damage from it; the page calls it a 'self-peel escape' without ever saying it displaces him, which is the detail that makes it predictable. (d) Short Fuse (P) is never mentioned: his empowered auto's cooldown is reduced every time he casts an ability, so poking you costs him nothing and speeds up his next hit.
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point and this page describes only Satchel Charge, in three near-identical sentences, with no cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Softened the minefield claim to the accurate version (the slow drags you off the pull angle) in whys[2] and wants.foe[1]; added the reduced-damage-on-repeat-hits rule to dontsFull[2].d and report[5].t; added the self-displacement and no-self-damage detail plus real 20s/12s cooldowns to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; put Short Fuse into dontsFull[0].d and Bouncing Bomb's 4s rank-5 cooldown into dontsFull[1].d.

notes: SAMPLE SIZE: packet.games is 6. Not zero, so per the rule I audited it rather than deferring, but the 46.95% win rate on this page is six games and should not be treated as a real number by anyone reading the audit. Nothing I changed depends on it — every edit comes from the kit text. DERIVED-FLAG MISFIRE (second type found this slice): Ziggs's Satchel Charge (W) carries percentHealth:'punishes HP stacking', and missingInteractions built a headline on it — 'Ziggs bypasses stacking resistances (Satchel Charge (W))'. Riot's own description of Satchel Charge says only 'deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away'; there is no percent-health component. The flag has almost certainly latched onto the 'hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets' clause. I did NOT write that claim, and I did not put an anti-resistance line into the itemisation — Mercury's Treads against an AP artillery mage remains correct. This is a different flag misfiring than the Mordekaiser Q grounding one, which suggests the tooltip parser has a general problem rather than one bad rule. Also left untouched but unverifiable from the kits: the claim in late, spikes[3] and whys[6] that Zhonya's stasis can run out the Realm of Death timer. It is plausible and it is not mine to remove on no evidence, but nothing in the brief confirms it — recorded in unverified.
